grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Using the Grapple costs 0 AP and can propel this soldier up to 15 tiles clearing this unit from all overwatching aliens. Single use only.

advanced-grapple.name: Advanced Grapple
advanced-grapple.description: Using the Grapple costs 0 AP and can propel this soldier up to 15 tiles clearing this unit from all overwatching aliens. 3 uses.

damage-control.name: Damage Control
damage-control.description: Grants +5% DR each time damage is received. If at full HP, grants +50 crit resist. If shredded, reduce shred to a maximum of 50% at end of turn.

repulsor.name: Repulsor
repulsor.description: If at full HP, non-psionic attacks are repulsed, causing them to graze (dealing only half of the original damage).

sealed.name: Sealed
sealed.description: Internal air supply and oxygen recycling systems grant the wearer immunity to strangulation.

flame-resistant.name: Flame Resistant
flame-resistant.description: Internal vapor chambers with intergrated cooling systems grant this unit with complete immunity to fire hazards.

tactical-mobility.name: Tactical Mobility
tactical-mobility.description: This unit gains 30 defense when in cover or flying. Does not apply to reaction fire. Disabled if this unit has been damaged this turn or is disoriented.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: Activate to turn invisible until your next action or next turn (2-turn cooldown). Cannot Ghost while Holo-Targeted. Attacks made while Ghosted gain +30 crit.

psi-boost.name: Psi Boost
psi-boost.description: Infuses explosives to deal 1 bonus psionic damage. Increases Kinetic Blast and Rift damage by 2. Reduces accumulation of fatigue by 20%.

advanced-psi-boost.name: Advanced Psi Boost
advanced-psi-boost.description: Infuses explosives to deal 2 bonus psionic damage. Increases Kinetic Blast and Rift damage by 4. Reduces accumulation of fatigue by 50%.
